method: HCCH status tables (hcch.net status-table/?cid=N) parsed for France, United States and EU rows; full text of every convention/protocol in force for France and/or the US from hcch.net full-text pages (EN; FR for France-only instruments, other language as text_<lang>), one record per article, stop at the testimonium. Instruments only signed (1985 Trusts; 2005 and 2019 for the US) or excluding family matters (2005, 2019) get a status record only.
gaps: HCCH 1970 Recognition of Divorces — excluded: binding on neither FR nor US (no signature/ratification in HCCH status table)
HCCH 1978 Celebration and Recognition of the Validity of Marriages — excluded: binding on neither FR nor US (no signature/ratification in HCCH status table)
HCCH 1989 Succession — excluded: binding on neither FR nor US (no signature/ratification in HCCH status table)
